name: Eastern Treads Limited
about: Eastern Treads Limited manufactures, sells, and deals in tread rubber, rubber-based adhesives, tyre retreading accessories, and retreading services in India. The company offers pre-cured tread rubber, such as truck bias, truck radial, truck mines, LCV patterns, car and auto patterns, and export patterns; conventional tread rubber comprising slab and camel-back treads; bonding gums for steam bonding and electric chamber process; black vulcanizing cement; and tyre repair patches for nylon and radial tyres. It also exports its products. The company sells its products through dealers and depots. Eastern Treads Limited was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Kochi, India.
